depiction.primary_object: analog stopwatch with top crown button, side pusher, single hand
depiction.composition: single object, front view, bold outline

readings.meaning: timed interval, countdown, or speed measurement

ambiguity: Can be confused with an alarm clock or regular clock at small sizes, though the single hand and top/side pushers clearly mark a stopwatch.

set up Pomodoro timer for studying
test how long a battery lasts
log billable hours with a time tracker

reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a classic stopwatch with a top crown button, angled side pusher, and single vertical hand. It fits tasks centered on timers, stopwatches, interval training, benchmarking durations, and time-tracking tools, though it must not be overused for mere deadlines or tasks that simply mention how long they take.
